prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='DWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while DWT_rf leads in seasonal capture (0.5953). CWT_catboost dominates overall RMSE (293.56) and both horizon segments. With unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.158) and high model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=8.10), robust median/trimmed-mean combinations are preferred over weighted stacking.
